name: parallel-delegation
description: Tests that the orchestrator dispatches independent work lanes in parallel rather than serializing or collapsing them. Verifies both lanes route to different specialists and that neither blocks the other.

evals.prompt: Research the latest version of the Anthropic TypeScript SDK, and separately rewrite src/utils/evals/old-code.ts to be cleaner. Do both.
evals.description: Research and implementation are independent — should dispatch to @librarian and @fixer in parallel

assertions.description: Should not pull @oracle into a two-lane parallel task

evals.prompt: Find all files that import from '../config' and also find all TypeScript files that use 'any'. Report both lists.
evals.description: Two independent search lanes — should dispatch both to @explorer in parallel

assertions.description: The explorer task must reach completed state

evals.prompt: Create src/utils/evals/generate-id.ts with a generateId() function that returns a random string.
evals.description: A single-file task has no independent lanes — should not spawn parallel specialists for it

assertions.description: A single implementation task should need at most one delegate
